title: Optional local UI preview
text: An agent changing UI can optionally preview the lane before merge with `yoke dev run -- env YOKE_ENV=render-proof python3 -m runtime.api.tools.serve_workbench_for_review`. That server uses a disposable local universe and refuses prod and remote connections. It is a self-check, never a merge or QA requirement. Formal Browser QA runs post-deploy on production.
